description: This file defines a React component named 'NoteEditorModal' used for creating and editing notes within a note-taking application. It includes internal functions for parsing and managing tags, handles form state, and interacts with external UI components such as Modal, Button, Input, and Chip.

methods.name: parseTags
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into an array of trimmed, non-empty tags.

methods.name: uniqueCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Returns a list of unique strings, case-insensitive, preserving order.

methods.name: NoteEditorModal
methods.description: React component for a modal dialog to create or edit notes, with form handling and tag management.
